nguyen_mirna_grayzone_RESOLVED.verdict: KEEP in holdout -> the fire is a SELF-COMPARISON pipeline artifact, NOT a detector-family membership
nguyen_mirna_grayzone_RESOLVED.why: anomaly=provenance_mismatch (Author Correction s41467-021-26533-z: 'wrong data were used for panel f'). Detection requires reading the correction notice; there is NO cross-locus comparison target inside the file. The annotator therefore filled source_a1_range == target_a1_range (D4:F4 == D4:F4, E4:G4==E4:G4, E2:G2==E2:G2) — src and tgt point to the SAME multi-cell range.
nguyen_mirna_grayzone_RESOLVED.mechanism: classify_relationship(a, a) on a len>=2 series trivially returns 'duplicate' — a series always equals itself. This is a degenerate self-comparison, not a forensic finding of two copied-but-nominally-independent series. The len<2 guard blocks single-cell self-compares (cf. florido X3:X3) but a 3-cell range (D4:F4) passes the guard and self-fires.
nguyen_mirna_grayzone_RESOLVED.annotator_confirms_disjoint: claim_001 text: 'no within-file structural artifact (duplicate column, fixed offset, paired ratio) flags this locus in the corrected data.'
nguyen_mirna_grayzone_RESOLVED.contrast_with_v1_aldometanib: OPPOSITE nature. aldometanib fired on TWO DISTINCT loci with a real fixed offset (+0.908) -> genuinely in detector family -> correctly EXCLUDED. nguyen fires on ONE locus compared to ITSELF -> degenerate artifact, case is genuinely disjoint -> KEEP.
nguyen_mirna_grayzone_RESOLVED.root_cause: classify_relationship lacks a self-comparison guard (identical series / same src==tgt locus). Recommended FAR-only fix below.

applied_fix.director_decision_2026_07_18: OPTION (a) — fix the detector. Root cause is in code (self-comparison carries zero forensic signal), so a code fix is correct and generalises to all future provenance-type cases, better than a per-case footnote.
applied_fix.change: added a self-comparison guard to l1_relationship_verifier (engine/benchmark/veritasbench_verifiers.py). Guard is keyed on LOCUS IDENTITY (src_label == tgt_label), NOT on value equality: same locus (same sheet+range) -> no fire; elementwise-identical series across TWO DISTINCT loci is a real cross-position copy-paste and STILL fires. Placed in the verifier (which has locus context), not in classify_relationship (which is pure math: a series does equal itself).
applied_fix.predicate_note: value-keyed would be WRONG — it would suppress genuine copy-paste fraud across distinct loci and kill B3's core ability. Locus-keyed only removes the tautology.
applied_fix.far_only_safety_PROVEN: A/B diff on the full 57-case main split (78 L1 claims): B3 fire-set WITH guard = 21, WITHOUT guard = 21, DIFFERENCES = 0. The guard is a strict no-op on the main-table deterministic B3 layer -> no published B1-B5 number changes. (The 3 src==tgt claims in the main split — rep_samplesize, rep_photoreceptor, rep_sarscov2 — are non-range-sourced, dropped by explicit_range_only=True, so B3 never loaded them anyway.)
applied_fix.golden_test: tests/unit/test_veritasbench_verifier_self_compare_guard.py locks BOTH directions: (i) same-locus identical series -> no fire; (ii) distinct-loci identical series + distinct-loci constant offset -> STILL fire. 5/5 pass (incl. existing trace/leak tests).
